name: code-buddy
description: Local governance, prompt quality, context handoffs, and analytics for Codex coding tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Governance and local analytics for Codex coding tasks.
interface.longDescription: Code Buddy captures Codex lifecycle events locally, enforces a developer-controlled preflight, reviews prompts, offers optional task decomposition and context handoffs, and refreshes local reports.
